assignments.reason: This is a compound node joining אמונה and תפלה — both already core members of Package 2. Its essential nature is the unity of faith and prayer, which is the defining theme of Package 2. The Torah states 'עִקַּר הַתְּפִלָּה הִיא עַל יְדֵי אֱמוּנָה' — prayer's foundation IS emunah. This node names that unity.

assignments.node_id: אמונה, שמאמין שהכל ברשות הקדוש ברוך הוא, אפלו לשנות הטבע. ואין הקדוש־ברוך־הוא מקפח שכר כל בריה, כי צדיק ה.
assignments.reason: An expanded description of אמונה — the belief that everything is in God's hands and He can change nature. This is the full content of the emunah that enables prayer. Its essential nature is faith, the core of Package 2. It causes prayer (eitza edge 3147: emunah → תפלה), but what it IS at its core is emunah — a Package 2 concept.

Proper/rectified prayer — a qualified form of תפלה. Its essential nature IS prayer, specifically prayer done correctly incorporating all its components (עפר, אפר, the three voices). This is the fullest expression of the prayer domain (Package 2). It causes the sparking of ancestral merit (eitza: תפלה כתקונו → מתנוצץ אור זכות אבות), but what it IS is prayer.

assignments.node_id: ירשת ארץ־ישראל, על־ידי המשכת קדשת ארץ־ישראל
assignments.reason: An expanded form of ירשת ארץ ישראל (already in Package 1). Its essential nature is inheriting and drawing down the holiness of Eretz Yisrael — the defining domain of Package 1. It causes the downfall of the wicked (eitza: ירשת ארץ ישראל → מפלתן של רשעים), but its nature IS the Land and its holiness.

Judging the wicked favorably (לימוד זכות). In section ג, this is the practical act that saves the tzaddik from the evil eye. Its essential nature is a dimension of prayer and faith — the Torah embeds it within the prayer narrative: God Himself judges the wicked favorably in order to protect the tzaddik, and the mechanism is the revelation of God's hand (יד ה') which creates a shadow (צל) of protection. The לימוד זכות is what activates the divine judgment system (משפט) that makes prayer possible. It belongs in the prayer/emunah domain as the inner posture that enables the tzaddik to pray effectively.

Teaching merit about the wicked — the same concept as למוד זכות, from the divine perspective (God judges the wicked favorably). Section ג: 'שֶׁמְּלַמְּדִין עָלָיו זְכוּת, עַל־יְדֵי־זֶה נִצּוֹל הַצַּדִּיק'. Its essential nature is the divine act of favorable judgment that enables the protective shadow — part of the prayer-and-protection mechanism of Package 2.

Being saved from the evil eye. Section ג establishes that this salvation comes through the bechina of Eretz Yisrael (section א: through the right side/ימין = EY, one sees the downfall of the wicked). The essential nature of this node is the outcome/fruit of Eretz Yisrael's holiness — protection from the wicked's gaze. It is the effect that manifests through Eretz Yisrael, and its nature as 'rescue/salvation' belongs in the domain of the Land's protective holiness rather than in the prayer domain per se.

assignments.node_id: נצול הצדיק מרע עין של הרשע
assignments.reason: The tzaddik being saved from the evil eye of the wicked — same essential concept as האדם נצול מרע עין הזה, specified for the tzaddik. In the teaching's structure, this salvation is the direct result of sitting at God's right hand (שב לימיני = Eretz Yisrael) while God subdues the enemies. The concept of divine protection through the Land's holiness places it in Package 1.

Good deeds. Section ו: 'עִקַּר חִזּוּק הַלֵּב, הוּא עַל יְדֵי מַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים'. Good deeds strengthen the heart, which is needed for the heart to contain wisdom without sinning. In this Torah, good deeds are the prerequisite for the heart's capacity (חיזוק הלב) that enables proper prayer. The essential nature of מעשים טובים is practical religious action — the moral-practical foundation of the prayer life. Since this Torah's entire framework is prayer vs. impaired prayer, and good deeds are what give the heart its strength to pray properly, this belongs in the prayer domain.

Strengthening the heart. Section ו defines this as the capacity of the heart to contain wisdom without it overflowing through the 'walls of the heart' (the אזוב problem). The additions file already notes that שרפה = חיזוק הלב (a bechina). The heart's strength is essential to prayer — without it, the philosophers' intellect leads to heresy instead of prayer. Its essential nature is the inner condition of the heart that enables prayer, squarely in the prayer/emunah domain.

The sparking of the light of ancestral merit. Section ב: 'עַל יְדֵי הִתְנוֹצְצוּת אוֹר זְכוּת אָבוֹת... אֲזַי נִתְגַּלֶּה קְדֻשַּׁת אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל'. The merit of the Forefathers is intrinsically linked to Eretz Yisrael — the Zohar passage 'בַּאֲתַר דְּאִית תַּמָּן אָבוֹת, אִית תַּמָּן שְׁכִינְתָּא' equates the presence of the Avot with the Shekhinah = חלה = ירשת ארץ ישראל. The three Avot are the 'legs of the throne' through which the Land's holiness is drawn down. Its essential nature is the patriarchal merit that IS the foundation of Eretz Yisrael's holiness.

Same concept as התנוצצות אור זכות אבות in verbal form — the merit of the Forefathers shining forth. Section ח: proper prayer causes this sparking, which in turn reveals Eretz Yisrael holiness. Its essential nature is the ancestral merit that is intrinsically bound to the Land of Israel.

Another verbal form of the same concept — when the merit of the Forefathers shines. Section ב: 'כְּשֶׁמִּתְנוֹצֵץ אוֹר זְכוּת אָבוֹת, אֲזַי נִתְגַּלֶּה קְדֻשַּׁת אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל'. The Forefathers' merit is the mechanism by which the Land's holiness is revealed. Its nature belongs to the Eretz Yisrael domain.

The ability to draw down the holiness of Eretz Yisrael. This is the effect described in section ב — through the sparking of ancestral merit, one can draw down the Land's holiness even in exile. Its essential nature IS the holiness of Eretz Yisrael being drawn/revealed — squarely Package 1.

Seeing the downfall of the wicked. Section א opens the entire Torah with: 'לִרְאוֹת בְּמַפַּלְתָּם שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים אִי אֶפְשָׁר אֶלָּא עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל'. This seeing is defined as the fruit/outcome of Eretz Yisrael — it is the manifestation of the Land's holiness in action. The concept of 'שֵׁב לִימִינִי עַד אָשִׁית אוֹיְבֶיךָ הֲדֹם לְרַגְלֶיךָ' (sit at my right = EY, until enemies are subdued) shows this seeing as the telos of the Land's holiness. Its nature belongs in Package 1.

The downfall of the wicked — same concept as לראות במפלתם של רשעים, expressed as the event itself rather than the seeing of it. Section ט: the entire Abba Shaul narrative links the downfall of the wicked (=מתים, the dead-while-living) to the pursuit of Eretz Yisrael (=צבי). This is the ultimate outcome of the Land's holiness. Its nature is in the EY domain.

assignments.node_id: לא די שנצול מרע עין של רשעים, אלא גם רואה בהם, מה שהם רצו לראות בו
assignments.reason: Not only saved from the evil eye of the wicked, but also seeing in them what they wanted to see in him — the double reversal. Section ב and ח describe this as the ultimate manifestation of Eretz Yisrael's holiness: 'וְעַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל, לֹא דַּי שֶׁנִּצּוֹל מֵרַע עַיִן שֶׁל רְשָׁעִים, אֶלָּא גַּם רוֹאֶה בָּהֶם'. This double outcome IS the power of the Land's holiness revealed.

assignments.node_id: נתגלה קדשת ארץ־ישראל. ולא די שהאדם נצול מהרשע, אלא גם רואה בהרשע מה שהרשע רצה לראות בו:
assignments.reason: A compound node combining the revelation of Eretz Yisrael's holiness with the double reversal of the evil eye. Both elements are manifestations of the Land's holiness (Package 1). Section ב: the entire passage describes how the sparking of ancestral merit reveals Eretz Yisrael's holiness, producing both salvation and reversal.

assignments.node_id: מתנוצץ אור שלשת אבות, שהם בבחינת רגלי הכסא, כדי להמשיך אור ארץ־ישראל
assignments.reason: The light of the three Forefathers (as legs of the throne) shining in order to draw the light of Eretz Yisrael. Section ט: this compound node explicitly names its purpose as drawing the light of Eretz Yisrael. The three Avot serve as the legs of the divine throne, and their shining is the means by which Eretz Yisrael's light enters the world. Its essential nature is the patriarchal foundation of the Land's holiness — Package 1.

assignments.node_id: תזכו למצא פני ה. כי על־ידי ארץ־ישראל תזכו לראות בהכריתות רשעים
assignments.reason: Meriting to find the face of God, through Eretz Yisrael seeing the destruction of the wicked. Section ט: 'עַל יְדֵי אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל תִּזְכּוּ לִמְצֹא פְּנֵי ה'. כִּי עַל יְדֵי אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל תִּזְכּוּ לִרְאוֹת בְּהַכְּרִיתוּת רְשָׁעִים'. This compound node explicitly attributes both effects (finding God's face and seeing the wicked's destruction) to Eretz Yisrael. Its essential nature is the ultimate spiritual fruit of the Land's holiness.
